item.title: I haven’t dated for years and want to try again. How do I prepare for the storm | Annalisa Barbieri
item.summary: Do you really want to date, or do you just feel you should? Be kind to yourself, and maybe try real-world dating and avoid the apps for now I haven’t been on a date in eight years and want to start next year. How can I prepare for the storm? I want to love and care for someone. I long for a supportive, funny life partner. Should I say that to a man? And is that too much in a dating profile? Continue reading...
